body.text: Run start: 2026-11-15T23:25:35Z, authoritative status. Stage 1 is reconstruction only through 2026-11-16T00:25:35Z. Goal: three toss/catch cycles, with spins before cycles 2 and 3 and a final spin/hold; deployment robustness to ball placement and uncertain contact physics. Will distinguish visible seam rotation from unobservable orientation, preserve palm-up wrist style, and build RL only after reconstruction stage.

Reference sphere fit gives median silhouette IoU 0.958; inferred shared gravity in camera [-0.0225,0.9704,0.2403]. Raw per-flight |a| 10.07,9.95,9.54 m/s2. Main risks are depth from partially occluded arcs and rotational observability. Refining ball depth temporally and fitting MANO by required HaWoR+default optimizer; will test seam/logo spherical optical flow with multi-frame closure before using spin angles.

Native validation of first complete reconstruction fails hand-ball penetration despite reasonable masks. Before recording VALID, testing stronger MANO penetration weighting and fixed unit scale; preliminary score pen falls9.9->3.8mm with IoU0.7277->0.7272. Gravity-only focal calibration at a fixed67mm gives770px versus MoGe1278px; this is resolved by diameter65.76mm within ITF65.4-68.6mm, illustrating coupled scale/focal uncertainty. Will preserve both hypotheses and quantify sensitivity.

body.text: Contact-aware MANO reference passes native anatomy and hand-ball checks: thumb contact100% each phase, opposed fractions1/1/.762/1; maxpenetration1.9mm. It introduces FCL finger intersections in15/315frames vs2/315 previously. During remaining stage1, testing conservative distal-bone separation10/12/14mm with fixed contact model (3200Adam iterations each), selecting by anatomical contact, all-vertex penetration, held-out mask agreement and FCL intersections. No robot simulation or RL yet.

Reference wrist measured from MANO anatomy: palm tilt median29deg, typical20-37deg; launch peaks about60deg; long-finger PIP curls decrease from about40-70deg held to20-40deg in flight. Flight intervals are conservative0.47/0.50/0.50s. First spin has visually and photometrically supported >140deg relative motion; short middle regrasp remains ambiguous. Expanding seam/logo matching across phases to connect rotation gauges, while retaining unobservable flags where matching fails.

Independent reconstruction diagnostics: SAM2 vs SAM3 ball masks medianIoU0.964, hand masks after common wristplane0.828. Atlas jointly optimized texture+rotations lowers self photometric loss but worsens independent pairwise warp correlations (e.g90->95 NCC0.645->-0.101), so reject those pose updates. Distal-bone20mm separation removes all315-frame FCL intersections (10/12mm ineffective,14mm leaves9frames); run full validation before retaining this hand fit.

body.text: Stage1 synthesis before deadline: four VALID reconstruction versions recorded, finalr0012. Strongest results are metric sphere translation, three flight/catch intervals and a contact-consistent315-frame MANO hand fit with no FCL intersections. Only56ball orientations are supported; primary4.0-4.467s gives103.6deg active relative turn while wristturns5.4deg. Rejected atlas pose refinement after independent image checks worsened; retained explicit rotational unobservability. Contact prior was corrected using object-only rebound tests at actualdt.001. Next: criteria from these measurements and task instruction, then robot simulation after00:25:35Z. No robot training simulation or policy has been built during stage1.

Robot scene first start test: the initially mild finger curl leaves the ball unsupported after it rolls toward the wrist; no hardware violation. The render shows nearly straight long fingers and thumb too far laterally. Searching stronger long-finger cupping and thumb opposition, with varied nominal centre and20-35deg palm tilt, on five placements each. This is start-pose/simulation validation before task suite registration, not a learned-policy result.

The full reconstructed initial wrist orientation has thumb-up28deg and fingers-down17deg; it holds102/128 broad placements with candidate194. Nominal shifts alone did not improve this enough. TASK explicitly allows choosing the start pose for placement robustness, so testing a symmetric palm-up cup with fingers-down20-35deg (same allowed tilt band) for placement, then retargeting the full demonstrated wrist orientation during active manipulation. Pose and deployment distribution are unchanged in the recorded criteria; the deviation will be explicit in primitive specs.

Simulation construction: exact public hand/controller via HandScene/CpuHand,128-vertex capped collision hulls on both CPU and GPU,analytic tennis sphere with reconstructed67mm scale and public shell inertia prior. Full-domain start check passes253/256 with0 scored-hold hardware episodes.61/256 placement-settling transients violate hardware before the episode; retain these diagnostics and do not claim placement dynamics validated. Raw kinematic finger retarget has19.6mm landmark error and30.9mm sphere penetration: reject as a physically executable reference. A projected contact-free illustration will expose its correction; use reference phase, wrist and object-motion features for learning, never penetration-filled joint replay as proof.
